title: rendeltem, fizettem, megerősítettem: What I Did Online

sections.title: The past tense online
sections.content: You know the past tense from Unit 24, and it works the same way for these verbs: *rendel* becomes *rendeltem* ("I ordered"), *fizet* becomes *fizettem* and *regisztrál* becomes *regisztráltam*. *megerősít* ("to confirm") carries the prefix *meg-* you know from Unit 22: *megerősítettem a foglalást* ("I confirmed the booking"). In the *I* form the definite and indefinite endings look the same, so *Rendeltem ebédet* and *Megerősítettem a foglalást* both end in *-tem*. For someone else the verb is shorter: *Kata rendelt ebédet.*

items.spanish: Tegnap online foglaltam jegyet a koncertre.
items.english: Yesterday I booked a ticket for the concert online.
Kata ordered lunch in the app.

items.spanish: Megerősítettem a foglalást, aztán kártyával fizettem.
items.english: I confirmed the booking, then I paid by card.

sections.content: A verb whose stem already ends in *-t* shows a double *tt* in the past: *fizettem*, *megerősítettem*. Do not confuse *megerősítettem* ("I confirmed") with the present *megerősítem* ("I confirm").
